name: Aberration-Space Holography
definition: A technique that combines individual propagation kernels, each expanded in an optimized basis set of aberrating functions (e.g., Zernike polynomials) and tailored for a specific target point, into a single spatial light modulator (SLM) hologram. This enables simultaneous, diffraction-limited control of multiple optical beams across the entire Nyquist-limited volume, correcting anisoplanatic aberrations that restrict parallel steering to small isoplanatic patches.
summary: Aberration-Space Holography generates computer-generated holograms that simultaneously correct spatially varying aberrations across an entire volume, enabling diffraction-limited parallel beam control beyond the limits of traditional isoplanatic methods.
